head: cd1f137
summary: Applied the owner's new durable_manifest_counts decision using exact registrations, with no runtime/comparator/test/threshold changes. Fresh full replay completes 12 scenarios/1769 steps and exactly reproduces all 3870 raw conductor failures. The 51 new exercised entries cover 220 fields and fully resolve 26 draft cases; registered-only projection is framework 17/17, reads 406/414, claims 291/316, drafts 312/323 (96.6%, 21.1% waived), AI 26/27. All five percentage thresholds are met; this is a verified projection from the supplied official board, not a new external conductor execution. Framework's observed 52.9% waiver share is unchanged and is not reported as below 25%; the latest supplied conductor does not flag it. Strict build, format, 978 fast tests and ten Python regressions pass. Previous 141 distinct heavy passing cases remain applicable. Active HALT retired; remaining exact-ID, status, stored-item program and figure-affecting decisions stay explicit. Nothing pushed; head pins the verified register commit before final documentation.

deviations.why: Earlier numeric prohibitions blocked honest convergence. The updated durable_manifest_counts decision permits exact operational counter registrations, and the supplied conductor now flags only drafts. Historical stopping evidence remains in the report and log.

Applying only those additions projects 312/323 drafts cases; no comparator, ownership, tolerance or threshold changed.

findings: Latest supplied official groups before new registrations: framework 17/17, reads 406/414, claims 291/316, drafts 286/323, AI 26/27. Only drafts is flagged below threshold.

51 new exercised entries cover 220 fields: 35 F18 entries cover 158 fields and 16 distinct source-binding entries cover 62 fields. All 36 newly covered numeric changes are exact authorized never_run or skip_candidates_upper_bound preview counters.

Registered-only projection fully resolves 26 draft cases, yielding 312/323 passes (96.6%) and 68/323 waivers (21.1%). Remaining policy fields project 2113 to 1893. Raw failures remain 3870 and are not represented as a zero-failure replay.

Eleven official draft cases/20 fields remain unwaived: seven identity/base-year durability, one source-state filter status, two stored work-item program-code cases and p2_run_batches:unknown-client at detail.detail (native error omits the echoed unknown client). The historical local diagnostic tolerates that last wording difference and has ten cases/19 fields; it is not used to claim another official pass.

The old convergence_board.py retains earlier policy/grouping and is not the current gate. The registration audit preserves every supplied official group and threshold except for removing exactly the newly covered draft cases.
Reads: 8 failed cases and 148 fields. Six concern unavailable-client or bounded-limit statuses; two involve later run identity and exact monetary-string scale.
Claims retains 25 failed cases within its passing 92.1% threshold: identity, attribution, status, zero-year filter and timestamp differences remain explicit backlog.
Python's independently unconfigured footprint reader silently returns empty state lists despite staged payroll; the configured source now reports actual states.
Python's unconfigured portal demonstration can answer an unrelated question; the offline merged host reads authorized canonical facts instead.
Stored deterministic IDs do not describe the ready-boundary UUID source state: four startup OpenTelemetry allocations are real and must be exported, not replaced with dummy draws.
Heavy fixture failures exposed stale draft-list authorization, duplicate test creation, omitted operational-table population and the intentionally retained zeroed write-sequence row.
Native DECIMAL4 formatting differs from some recorded money strings. Equal arithmetic value does not establish money-string scale equivalence.

Raw replay is execution-complete, not zero-failure semantic parity. The required percentage thresholds pass under the updated policy and audited registrations. Mock gateway remains deferred; sealed and unassigned buckets are visible.

The resumed conductor's additional failures were a real external setup defect: reset-url sent an empty body and applied no scenario auth. Raw p1_auth/P2-read/P2-batch failures dropped from 1029/888/498 to 182/148/215 after correcting that path.

The newest fresh one-host replay matches every ordered field of the supplied conductor's 3870 raw failures. No .NET runtime or test changed in this resume. The host was verified responsive and stopped in finally.

Negative boundary checks confirm no new registration covers changed existing last-run IDs, client/item populations, execution success counts, existing program counts, statuses or certified eligibility figures.
